title: A Veil for the Choir Anew
author: I. M. Fairweather
blurb: Noor Kavanagh, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
